sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which specialized tool is essential in a plant nursery for creating small, precise holes in soil to sow seeds or transfer young saplings safely?
What is the primary function of a mordant, such as alum or common salt, in the tie and dye textile process?
options: A) To stitch the fabric together tightly
B) To bind and permanently fix dye pigment into fabric fibers
C) To bleach the fabric completely white
D) To make the fabric completely waterproof
questions.answer: B) To bind and permanently fix dye pigment into fabric fibers

questions.question_text: The intentional selection and growing of nectar-rich native plants in a school habitat garden to attract butterflies and bees is known as __________.
Which lightweight growing medium component is widely mixed into nursery potting soil to enhance moisture retention and aeration?
In the traditional 'Bandhani' tie and dye craft, what item is tightly wound around folded fabric sections to prevent dye absorption and create intricate spot patterns?

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Describe the key steps involved in preparing a fertile potting mixture for seedling trays in a plant nursery. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Mix garden soil, organic compost, and coco peat equally. Ensure the mixture is well-sieved, lightweight, and well-draining to promote rapid seed germination and healthy root growth.

questions.question_text: Explain why native plant species are preferred over exotic ornamental plants when setting up a school habitat garden. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Native plants adapt easily to local weather, require minimal water or fertilizers, and provide essential food and shelter to indigenous birds, butterflies, and beneficial garden insects.

questions.question_text: Outline the basic practical procedure for washing and setting dyed fabric after completing a tie and dye activity. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Rinse dyed fabric under cold running water until excess dye washes off completely. Dip the cloth in a mild salt solution to fix colors, then dry in shade.

questions.question_text: As a team member responsible for setting up a mini habitat garden project in your school, detail how you would select a suitable plot and integrate compost making. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: Select an unused, well-lit plot with natural drainage. Clear weeds and aerate the topsoil using hand trowels. Set up a compost bin nearby using fallen leaves and cafeteria organic waste to continuously provide nutrient-rich natural humus to habitat plants.
